title: “シチーガール”になるために

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On my day off, I head out to a large suburb… only to run into Yukino Bijin struggling with a vending machine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I just plain don't get it. I'm sure I heard someone say'n you could use e-cash with these vend'n machines.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Grr… I've gotta keep at it! If I'm gonna be a city girl, I need t'learn how t'use all these fancy devices!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like she doesn't know how to use her payment app to buy a drink from the vending machine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trust you t'know the trick, Trainer! I had no idea you were s'posed to press the button first!
choice_data_list: Did you come here just to hang out too?
Did you come here just to hang out too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yep. I thought I'd better get m'self used to the city if I'm gonna be a city girl. I've been stopp'n by all the citiest places.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The thing is, ev'rywhere I turn, all I see is city, city, city… I've got no idea where I should go.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And I can't even buy a drink right. It's putt'n a real damper on my day… Maybe I should just head on home.
choice_data_list: Want to walk around together?
Want to walk around together?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Really? I'd like that! As long as you're with me, I feel practic'lly unstoppable!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: In that case, could y'bring me someplace that screams "city" to you? Pretty please!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's dive right into the deep end!
Yeah, let's dive right into the deep end!
Let's go somewhere with a view of the whole city.
How about we go window shopping?
How about we go window shopping?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: In that case, could y'bring me someplace that screams "city" to you? Pretty please!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's dive right into the deep end!
Yeah, let's dive right into the deep end!
Let's go somewhere with a view of the whole city.
How about we go window shopping?
How about we go window shopping?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Th-the deep end? Jinkies, that sounds so intense!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, I decide to take her to a famous Umamusume and racing merchandise shop.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa… I thought the only place you could find shops like this was at racecourses… It's like there's noth'n the city doesn't have!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And golly, lookit the size of this place! The shelves alone go on for miles!
choice_data_list: I'm pretty sure this shop takes up every floor in the building.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! This place's on a whole nother level!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: We've gotta check out every floor! I bet they've got City merch on display in the nicest spot!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But this place is massive! We're gonna have t'really buckle down if we're gonna find her stuff. …Hm?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Digital! Talk about gett'n lucky! We couldn't have bumped into a better person!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-whaahadsg?! A surprise attack of pureness out of nowhere?! B-by Yukino the Snow Angel?! My soul is ablaze!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, um, m-my apologies! Inhale… Exhale… Is there anything I can do for you?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, uh… It's kinda embarass'n, but I'm not really used t'stores this massive.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Could y'give us a general lay of the land so we can find what we're look'n for?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah! I see! So you too wish to venture into this world?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeppers! T'day I'm div'n into the deep end!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Very well! …Hmm. You can find anything and everything online nowadays, but nothing beats feasting your eyes at a brick and mortar!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Central Umamusume! Regional Umamusume! Umamusume from every generation! Allow me to show you everything this store has to offer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-you'd do all that for me?! Thanks so much! I can't wait t'see it all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I bet being able t'shop at spiffy stores like these will help me become the city girl of my dreams!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without addressing that remark, I watch as Yukino Bijin follows Agnes Digital around and fully immerses herself into her world.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Gett'n a gorgeous view of the city sounds like a real gas!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Golly! Th-this is amaz'n! Those build'ns were so huge, but from up here it's like they could fit in the palm of my hand!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There's always someth'n bigger out there, huh? So this is what it's like t'climb a skyscraper! What a spiffy view!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You sure know your stuff when it comes to the city, Trainer! Thanks a bunch for shar'n this beautiful scenery with me!
choice_data_list: You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But… Hm… For whatever reason, it all feels strangely familiar.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know what it is! This reminds me of when I was a kid look'n out over Morioka from the mountain observation deck!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Seeing my hometown shrunk down so small on the top of that mountain… I r'member want'n to visit all the places I could see!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. I can't go gett'n sheepish. I've gotta open up my heart again—just like I did back then!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do that! I wanna stroll through this stunn'n city with my own two legs!
choice_data_list: Sounds like you're starting to get used to the big city.
Sounds like you're starting to get used to the big city.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You bet. Ehehe… Hopefully that means I'm one step closer to being a city girl.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Why don't we decide our next stop from here?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Trainer! This way! Let's look through the telescope!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin and I spend the rest of the day strolling around the city. She looks proud to have taken one step closer to becoming a city girl.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's a must! C'mon, we've got shopp'n t'do!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! These shops're colossal! And every one of 'em looks so glam'rous!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Ah! I'd better reel myself in. It's not cool to stand around gawk'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A city girl'd be walk'n around like she owns the place! Okay, here goes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'll just pretend like I'm stroll'n 'round the mall in Morioka!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Noth'n like window shopp'n to put some pep in your step! Y'know, I feel like I might be gett'n used to this city atmosphere… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But all those crowds tuckered me out a teensy bit… I'd like t'find somewhere we can rest for a sec—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Wait, am I smell'n what I think I'm smell'n?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pears, jajamen, yogurt… What's all this Morioka stuff doing here?!
choice_data_list: It's a shop that sells things from Iwate.
It's a shop that sells things from Iwate.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Good gracious! The mem'ries are flood'n back!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer, these chilled noodles're delicious! I'm gonna grab a pack.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But wow! I never thought I'd find stuff from back home in a fancy place like this.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Being surrounded by the things you're not used to makes this familiar stuff all the more sooth'n…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Hehe.
choice_data_list: What?
What?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There's always so much more to the city than meets the eye. It's not all huge build'ns, flash'n lights, or glitz and glam.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There's places even a bumpkin like me can feel at home.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Y'know, I think I'm start'n to get a feel for the city! Just a smidge!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After learning about the different sides to the city, Yukino Bijin looks pleased with her growth as a city girl.
